nimael_1.m: Please help us. We got raided.

nimael_2.m: I don't know exactly. Everything went so fast ... I'm too upset and my head hurts too much.

nimael_3.m: If you want to help us, please talk to Gison.

r: I only hope it'll be worth the trouble.

nimael_arg_10.m: Yes. Vegetables with forest herbs. It is even better than my husband's mushroom soup.

nimael_arg_20.m: Well, here is a small taste of mine, and a small taste of his. I am sure you will agree with me.
r: I think they are both good. One is not better than the other, just different. Different people have different tastes, so perhaps it is better that you offer both, rather than arguing over which is better?

nimael_arg_30.m: For a kid, that's a very insightful comment. I will talk to my husband about how we can better sell both soups to the townsfolk in Fallhaven. Here are a couple of bottles of my soup as thanks.

nimael_b1.m: It's nice to see you again. I have some exciting news to share.

nimael_b2.m:
Thanks to your advice, we have been successful selling more soup to the townsfolk in Fallhaven.
We have even cooperated to craft new recipes.
We also give free samples of our latest soups to those that buy from us, so they know what is on offer.
r: I'm glad I could help. You sell more soup, and the people in Fallhaven get more choices. Everyone wins!

nimael_busy.m: I'm busy at the moment. Please talk to Gison. He's over there.
r: Alaun told me that you also make very good soup.
While exploring the Sullengard forest, I stumbled across this giant mushroom and was wondering if you knew what it was.

nimael_pm_0.m: Sure, kid, let me take a look.
r: Never mind. I have to go now.

nimael_pm_10.m:
Ah, what you have here is called the Diervilla Cobaea, or more commonly known as the Gloriosa, it is an extremely rare, but highly poisonous fungus most commonly found in dark, shadowy places like forests.
It's a defense mechanism as it is poisonous for most creatures, including humans, when ingested.

nimael_pm_20.m: Actually, quite the opposite in fact. You see, Gison and I have perfected the process of removing the poison and using it in our soups. I can do this for you if you like.
r: No, thank you. I think I will hang onto it for a little bit and see if I can find a better use for it.

nimael_pm_25.m: Well, if you change your mind, you know where to find me.

nimael_pm_30.m: I just need a little bit of time. Please come back soon and I will have your soup ready.

nimael_pm_45.m: No, not yet. You must have patience. Making the Gloriosa soup safe to eat takes time.

nimael_pm_50.m: Yes. Please enjoy while it's hot.

In a hut southwest from Fallhaven I met Alaun.
He asked me to bring him some of the delicious soup made by Gison with forest mushrooms.
Gison's house lies to the south.

gison_soup.28: Gison gave me a new soup for 5000 gold. I should really go to Alaun now.

Alaun received the soup.
I should take the empty bottle back to Gison.

I spent 5555 gold on buying mushroom soup! Am I crazy? 
There is no soup left for Alaun now.

gison_cookbook.10: Gison, the man with the mushroom soup in the forest south of Fallhaven, got raided. Only his cookbook was stolen and he asked me to bring it back to him.
gison_cookbook.20: Gison said the thieves came from the south. I should begin my search there.
gison_cookbook.30: I discovered a hidden cave. The thieves may be hiding there.
gison_cookbook.40: I found the thieves. Their leader was performing some kind of ritual when I came into the cave.
gison_cookbook.60: I brought the cookbook back to Gison. The thieves were working for Zuul'khan, the fungi sorcerer. They made a second copy of the book without the strange writing, which Gison gladly accepted. Gison can now cook his mushroom soup again.
gison_cookbook.62: I told Gison that I found the thieves, but that they had destroyed the cookbook.
gison_cookbook.70: Gison will give me mushroom soup in thanks if I bring him 50 gold, 2 of Bogsten's mushrooms and an empty bottle.
